metadata.description: Marketing automation plugins from SE Ranking and Planable — content lifecycle and cross-channel marketing skills for Claude, Cursor, and Codex. Powered by the SE Ranking and Planable MCP servers.

plugins.name: content-refresh
plugins.description: Audit → approve → refresh. Finds decayed content with SE Ranking data (and real Search Console ground truth if connected), diagnoses why each page dropped, and generates surgical, fact-checked update drafts. Two skills: refresh-audit (analyze + propose) and refresh-update (write the approved refreshes). No databases, no channels — everything happens in chat and plain files. Requires the SE Ranking and Firecrawl MCPs; Planable is not needed.

plugins.name: content-skills
plugins.description: Content Skills for Claude, by SE Ranking & Planable. Ten content-lifecycle pipelines on live SE Ranking + Planable data: campaign briefs with distribution and tracking, keyword clusters on a 12-week calendar, batch content refresh, socially validated niche plans, article-to-social packs, social-to-SEO idea mining, gap-to-content sprints, AI-visibility recovery, page recovery with a relaunch gate, and a shared brand profile.

plugins.name: ecosystem-skills
plugins.description: The three core SE Ranking + Planable ecosystem use cases in one focused plugin: map a brand's whole footprint across search rankings, AI answers and social; turn real search demand into a drafted social campaign in Planable; and claim the AI-answer narratives competitors own. See → act → see again, with every campaign instrumented — label plus baseline passport — so re-running the map proves what moved. Requires both MCPs.

plugins.name: marketing-skills
plugins.description: Cross-channel marketing skills connecting SE Ranking (SEO + AI-search data) with Planable (social content workflow), organized as a pipeline: diagnose (gap matrix, AI-visibility benchmark, demand audits), act (campaigns, briefs, launches drafted in Planable), measure (campaign impact verdicts, cross-channel reports). Every campaign ships instrumented — label plus baseline passport — so results are provable. Requires both MCPs.
